c003.title: The Empty Room
c003.briefing.summary: Julian Ashby, an auditor in town for a client meeting, checked into room 614 of the Halden last night. At 08:00 he missed breakfast with his colleague Priya Nair. At 08:35 housekeeping found his door ajar, his bed untouched, and his suitcase and phone still in the room. The night staff insist nobody could have left the hotel unseen.
c003.briefing.objective1: How did Julian leave the hotel?
c003.briefing.objective2: Who most likely helped him leave unseen?
c003.person.julian.name: Julian Ashby
c003.person.priya.name: Priya Nair
c003.person.grace.name: Grace Okafor
c003.person.theo.name: Theo Lindqvist
c003.e01.title: Priya Nair's statement
c003.e01.body:
Interviewed 08:50.

“Julian and I were meeting at eight to rehearse a client presentation. He never came down. Last night at 23:41 he texted me: ‘Change of plan. I'm fine. Will explain.’ I'm staying across town; I wasn't at the Halden last night.”
c003.f01a: Priya says Julian never came down for their 08:00 breakfast meeting.
c003.f01b: At 23:41 Julian texted Priya: ‘Change of plan. I'm fine. Will explain.’
c003.e02.title: Grace Okafor's statement
c003.e02.body:
Interviewed 09:05.

“I was on the front desk from ten until six. Mr Ashby never came down. A guest can only leave past my desk or through the fire exit, and that's alarmed.”
c003.f02a: Grace says she was at the front desk from 22:00 to 06:00 and never saw Julian come down.
c003.f02b: Grace says the only ways out are past the front desk or through the alarmed fire exit.
c003.e03.title: Theo Lindqvist's statement
c003.e03.body:
Interviewed 09:15.

“Quiet night. No calls from the rooms after eleven. I sat at the porter desk in the luggage room the whole shift.”

The porter desk is in the luggage room off the staff corridor. No camera covers it.
c003.f03a: Theo says he took no calls from guest rooms after 23:00.
c003.f03b: Theo says he never left the porter desk all night.
c003.e04.title: Room 614 door-lock record
c003.e04.body:
Electronic lock, room 614, 26–27 October 2026.

21:12 — guest key card 1
23:48 — staff master key MK-2

The lock records every key card that opens the door from the corridor. Leaving the room from inside is not recorded.
c003.f04a: At 21:12 room 614 was opened with guest key card 1.
c003.f04b: At 23:48 room 614 was opened with staff master key MK-2.
c003.f04c: No card opened room 614 after 23:48. Leaving the room from inside is never recorded.
c003.e05.title: Switchboard log
c003.e05.body:
Hotel switchboard, room 614, 26 October 2026.

23:40 — incoming outside call, number withheld, 3 min
23:44 — outgoing call to the porter desk, answered, 1 min
c003.f05a: At 23:40 room 614 received a three-minute outside call from a withheld number.
c003.f05b: At 23:44 room 614 called the porter desk; the call was answered and lasted one minute.
c003.e06.title: Housekeeping report, room 614
c003.e06.body:
Reported 08:35 by housekeeper Ines Duarte.

The door of room 614 was ajar, held open by its brass swing bar, so it couldn't close and lock. The photo, taken from just inside the door, shows the bed still made, with the turndown chocolate on the pillow. A closed dark suitcase sits on the luggage rack and a phone lies face down on the desk. The wardrobe stands open with empty hangers. There is no overcoat and no laptop bag anywhere in the room.
c003.f06a: At 08:35 the door of room 614 was ajar, held open by its swing bar.
c003.f06b: The bed in room 614 had not been slept in.
c003.f06c: Julian's suitcase and phone were in the room; no overcoat or laptop bag was found.
c003.e07.title: Floor plan and exit guide
c003.e07.body:
The Halden's fire-and-exit plan for the sixth floor, with the staff notes from the building manual.

Guests reach the lobby by the two guest lifts. The fire stair runs from the top floor to the street. A separate staff-only service lift serves every floor and the basement loading dock, which opens onto the rear lane.
c003.f07a: Guest-room windows above the first floor are sealed and do not open.
c003.f07b: A staff-only service lift runs from every floor to the basement loading dock; it needs a staff key card.
c003.f07c: The fire stair has one way out: an alarmed door to the street. It has no door into the lobby.
c003.e08.title: Lobby camera review
c003.e08.body:
The hotel's security contractor reviewed every lobby camera from 21:00 to 08:00 for Julian.

The CCTV frame shows him at 21:09 stepping into a guest lift in a grey overcoat, with a laptop bag over his shoulder. After that he doesn't appear again.
c003.f08a: At 21:09 Julian is seen entering a guest lift in the lobby.
c003.f08b: At 21:09 Julian is wearing a grey overcoat and carrying a laptop bag.
c003.f08c: Julian does not appear on the lobby or entrance cameras between 21:10 and 08:00.
c003.f08d: The hotel's cameras cover only the lobby, front desk, main entrance and guest lifts.
c003.f08e: The front desk is staffed on camera throughout the night.
c003.e09.title: Fire-exit alarm record
c003.e09.body:
Alarm panel, fire-exit street door, 26–27 October 2026.

No alarm events between 21:00 and 08:00.
06:00 — scheduled test: passed.
c003.f09a: The fire-exit street door raised no alarm between 21:00 and 08:00.
c003.f09b: The fire-exit alarm passed its scheduled test at 06:00.
c003.e10.title: Night-shift and master-key register
c003.e10.body:
The handwritten master-key sheet and the night rota.

MK-1 — G. Okafor — out 22:00, back 06:00
MK-2 — T. Lindqvist — out 22:00, back 06:05

Night shift: Grace Okafor, night manager; Theo Lindqvist, night porter.
c003.f10a: Master key MK-2 was signed out to night porter Theo Lindqvist at 22:00 and returned at 06:05.
c003.f10b: Master key MK-1 was signed out to night manager Grace Okafor; no other master keys were issued overnight.
c003.f10c: Theo Lindqvist was the only porter on the night shift.
c003.e11.title: Compliments slip from the desk drawer
c003.e11.body:
Found in the desk drawer of room 614, on top of the hotel notepad.

A cream compliments slip with a thin brass circle crossed by a single line, above the words “The Meridian Trust”. Nothing else is printed or written on it. Housekeeping can't say how long it had been there.
c003.f11a: A blank compliments slip printed ‘The Meridian Trust’ was in the desk drawer of room 614; it bears no name, date or handwriting.
c003.e12.title: Service-lift log
c003.e12.body:
Supplied by the building's lift-maintenance contractor, not by the hotel.

23:49 — called to floor 6 with key MK-2
23:51 — arrived at the basement loading dock

No other trips between 23:00 and 05:30.
c003.f12a: At 23:49 master key MK-2 called the service lift to the sixth floor; it reached the basement loading dock at 23:51.
c003.f12b: No other service-lift trips were made between 23:00 and 05:30.
c003.e13.title: Loading-dock camera stills
c003.e13.body:
Supplied by the delivery contractor whose camera covers the loading dock. It isn't part of the hotel's system.

23:51: the service-lift doors open and two people walk out, seen from behind. One wears a hotel porter's uniform, a navy waistcoat over a white shirt. The other wears a grey overcoat and carries a laptop bag.

23:58: the person in the grey overcoat walks alone up the rear lane and gets into a waiting taxi, unhurried. Neither face is visible in either frame.
c003.f13a: At 23:51 two people step out of the service lift at the loading dock: one in a hotel porter's uniform, one in a grey overcoat carrying a laptop bag.
c003.f13b: At 23:58 the person in the grey overcoat walks alone up the rear lane and gets into a waiting taxi.
c003.f13c: Neither face is visible in the stills.
c003.d01.title: Julian went up to room 614
c003.d01.description: He stepped into a guest lift at 21:09, and his key card opened room 614 three minutes later.
c003.d02.title: Not through the lobby, not by the fire exit
c003.d02.description: After he went up, the lobby cameras never saw Julian again, and the fire-exit door never raised an alarm all night. He left some other way, or never left.
c003.d03.title: There is a third way down
c003.d03.description: Grace counts only two ways out, but the staff service lift runs from every floor to the basement loading dock and bypasses the lobby completely.
c003.d04.title: The porter desk took a call from room 614
c003.d04.description: Theo says no room called him after 23:00, yet the switchboard shows room 614 called the porter desk at 23:44 and someone answered.
c003.d05.title: Theo's master key opened room 614
c003.d05.description: Four minutes after that call, room 614 was opened with MK-2, the master key signed out to Theo. A key record shows which key was used, not whose hand held it.
c003.d06.title: Two people rode the service lift down
c003.d06.description: Key MK-2 took the service lift from the sixth floor to the loading dock, and at 23:51 the dock camera shows two people stepping out of it.
c003.d07.title: Julian left in a taxi, of his own accord
c003.d07.description: The person who left by taxi at 23:58 wore Julian's grey overcoat and carried his laptop bag, and walked away alone and unhurried.
c003.d08.title: He took his coat and bag, nothing else
c003.d08.description: Julian arrived with a grey overcoat and a laptop bag, and neither was left in the room. He left behind his suitcase and his phone.
c003.d09.title: A call changed his plans
c003.d09.description: One minute after a three-minute call from a withheld number, Julian texted Priya that his plans had changed.
c003.d10.title: Theo's key wasn't at the porter desk
c003.d10.description: Theo says he never left the porter desk, but the key signed out to him was riding the service lift at 23:49.
c003.a01.title: Request the service-lift log and the loading-dock camera
c003.a01.justification: Julian didn't leave through the lobby or the fire exit, but the staff service lift bypasses both. Minutes after room 614 called the porter desk, the master key signed out to Theo opened the room. The lift and the loading-dock camera belong to the building's contractors, so ask them for their records.
c003.c01.question: How did Julian leave the hotel?
c003.c01.service_lift: By the service lift to the loading dock
c003.c01.fire_exit: Down the fire stair and out of the fire exit
c003.c02.question: Who most likely helped Julian leave unseen?
c003.hint.r01: The cameras saw Julian go up. Does anything record him reaching his room?
c003.hint.r02: If Julian walked out, which records would have noticed?
c003.hint.r03: Grace lists two ways out. Does the floor plan agree?
c003.hint.r04: Theo says the phones were quiet. What does the switchboard say?
c003.hint.r05: A staff key opened 614 just before midnight. Whose key was it that night?
c003.hint.r06: The lift log and the dock camera both mention 23:51.
c003.hint.r07: Who left in the taxi? Compare what they wore with what Julian wore that evening.
c003.resolution:
Theo Lindqvist took Julian down the service lift.

Julian rode up to room 614 at 21:09 and never came back through the lobby. At 23:40 an outside caller who withheld their number spoke to him for three minutes. A minute later he texted Priya that his plans had changed. At 23:44 he rang the porter desk.

Theo answered. He came up with master key MK-2 and took Julian down the staff service lift to the loading dock, where no hotel camera was watching. At 23:58 Julian walked up the rear lane to a waiting taxi. Theo flipped the swing bar so he could come back for the suitcase after his shift, but the morning staff arrived first. He denied everything because taking cash to slip a guest out by the service lift would have cost him his job.

At 10:20 Julian called Priya from a train. He was safe. He said the caller had told him the morning meeting wasn't what it seemed, and that he should leave quietly that night, without his phone. He wouldn't say more over the phone.

Nobody knows who made that call, or whether the compliments slip in his drawer has anything to do with it.
